reason: I don't buy anything until I've read the reviews and seen photos on women my age, and this has none, only Facebook ads. At $36 for a lip balm I'd want proof first, so I'd bookmark it and wait.
objection: Zero reviews and sold only through ads. A 365-day guarantee is easy to promise, but I don't know if a small new brand will actually honor it, or what the pink looks like on older lips with lines.
would_change_my_mind: A good number of real reviews on Trustpilot or Amazon with photos from women in their 60s showing the color and no bleeding into lip lines.
